fields.sql: WITH `p0` (`c0`, `c1`) AS (SELECT `m0`.`id` AS `c0`, `m1`.`id` AS `c1` FROM `phase66`.`phase66_rows` AS `m0` LEFT JOIN `phase66`.`phase66_rows` AS `m1` ON (`m0`.`id` > `m1`.`id`)), `p1` (`c0`, `c1`, `c2`) AS (SELECT `m2`.`c0` AS `c0`, `m2`.`c1` AS `c1`, `m3`.`id` AS `c2` FROM `p0` AS `m2` INNER JOIN `phase66`.`phase66_rows` AS `m3` ON (`m2`.`c1` = `m3`.`id`)) SELECT `t0`.`c0` AS `a`, `t0`.`c2` AS `b` FROM `p1` AS `t0`
